structural.note: True duplicate: 'watermelon melon seed' (id watermelon-melon-seed, child of melon-seed, no aliases) and 'watermelon seed' (id watermelon-seed, root, real aliases 'watermelon seeds'/'citrullus seed') are the same edible seed. Keep the canonical watermelon-seed; fold the empty melon-seed child in. (Distinct from egusi-seed, the gourd-seed stew base, which is left untouched.)
Bare-token id: 'bbq' is a generic flavor modifier that pollutes id-space and risks mis-resolution; the item is specifically the BBQ corn-nut flavor (name already 'bbq corn nut', parent corn-nut).

Bare-token id: 'ranch' is a generic flavor word that collides conceptually with ranch dressing (ranch-dressing already aliases 'ranch'). The item is the ranch corn-nut flavor (name 'ranch corn nut', parent corn-nut).
Bare-token id: 'striped' is a generic modifier; the item is specifically the striped (snacking) sunflower-seed variety (name 'striped sunflower seed', parent sunflower-seed).

Bare-token id: 'honeydew' is the melon name and collides with honeydew-melon (Produce, which aliases 'honeydew'). This item is only the honeydew melon SEED (name 'honeydew melon seed', parent melon-seed); give it a non-colliding id.
Bare-token id: 'unhulled' is a generic processing modifier; the item is specifically unhulled sesame seed (name 'unhulled sesame seed', parent sesame-seed).

cleanups.note: Child 'unhulled sesame seed' wrongly carried the parent's generic aliases verbatim, so a query for 'sesame seeds' matched both canonical sesame-seed AND this varietal child — ambiguous mis-resolution. Drop the generic alias from the child (parent sesame-seed keeps it). [id is post-reid unhulled -> unhulled-sesame-seed]
Same parent-collision: 'til' (Hindi for sesame) belongs to canonical sesame-seed, not the unhulled child. Remove to stop the varietal hijacking generic sesame queries.
Same parent-collision: 'benne seed' is the generic sesame name (kept on sesame-seed); drop from the unhulled child.
Same parent-collision: 'gingelly seed' is the generic sesame name (kept on sesame-seed); drop from the unhulled child.
Over-broad bare alias: 'mixed' exact-matches any 'mixed ...' query and hijacks it to mixed-nuts. Generic modifier, not a name for this product.
Over-broad alias: bare 'nuts' is the generic plural of the 'nut' parent, not specifically mixed nuts; it captures generic nut queries into the trail-mix item.
Over-broad/duplicative: 'nut mix' is a bare generic; mixed-nuts already keeps the specific 'nuts mix'/'assorted nuts'. Removing the bare form reduces generic-query capture.
Wrong-product alias: 'almond flavor' is almond extract/flavoring (a Baking & Sweeteners liquid), not the almond nut. A recipe calling for almond flavor would mis-resolve to the whole nut.

Junk pseudo-alias: 'water chestnut excluded' is an authoring note, not a real alias — it would literally match a query containing those words and pull water-chestnut searches into chestnut. (water-chestnut is a distinct Produce item.)
Junk pseudo-alias: 'bitter kola excluded' is an authoring exclusion note, not an alias; remove so it can't match 'bitter kola' queries and mis-resolve them to kola-nut.
